question: On oversold BOUNCE setups (3rd down close), does lower turnover (illiquid, per Asian Amihud/size premium studies) produce higher stop-R than higher turnover, or does our prior finding (illiquid=worse) hold outside burst?
plain: Testing whether thinly-traded stocks bounce back better after 3 down days, as size/illiquidity-premium research (MAS 2022 Asian markets study) suggests, versus our earlier finding that illiquid stocks do worse.
